splash.tagline: Making marriage easier — with dignity and privacy

brand.subtitle: A non-profit platform for easier marriage
brand.description: We unite good efforts to reduce marriage costs in Yemen, starting from Sanaa.

mission.title: Our mission
mission.description: Easier marriage through disciplined assistance, group weddings and trusted partners. Choosing a spouse is the families' responsibility; the platform never mediates it.

assistance.title: Assistance
assistance.description: Disciplined financial assistance with human eligibility review.

weddings.title: Our Wedding
weddings.description: Group weddings that reduce costs for families.

partners.title: Partners
partners.description: Discounts from trusted partners serving couples-to-be.

souk.title: Souk Khair
souk.description: In-kind donations between families. No money inside the app.

noDating.title: No dating
noDating.description: No dating services and no partner search inside the app.

encrypted.title: Your data is encrypted and protected
encrypted.description: We protect your data. We never sell it or share it without consent.

noPublicProfiles.title: No public profiles
noPublicProfiles.description: No public personal profiles; access is minimal and restricted to authorized roles.

language.title: Choose your language
language.description: Arabic is the default language. English is foundational.
language.directionNote: Texts switch immediately; the native layout direction fully applies after reopening the app.
